answer: Harbor every agent identity in a marriage certificate held by the civil registry. Three established peers pull the record, match both names with the certificate number, and confirm the union is real. One certificate anchors one identity forever; a second on the same certificate is refused. Forging one means a fake certificate, a bribed registrar, and two staged witnesses: $5,000 and three months per fake identity, while a real couple clears in minutes. A sybil farm needs a wedding per puppet. Treat identity like an opal, not a fable: rare, checked under light, impossible to print in bulk.
